title: DiscoveryAgent: A Framework for Scientist-centric Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.21950v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents can assist scientific research, but balancing autonomous investigation with scientists' ability to inspect and redirect ongoing work remains a central design challenge. We present DiscoveryAgent, a domain-agnostic, scientist-centric system that combines autonomous investigation with scientist-directed hypothesis steering. Scientists select, refine, or replace hypotheses between research rounds, while audit agents interrogate checkpointed records to trace claims, reproduce analyses, and inform subsequent decisions. Across two predictive modeling tasks, DiscoveryAgent produced the best variable-star classifier among evaluated baselines and, with scientist steering, a protein variant-effect predictor surpassed by only one of 106 ProteinGym baselines. translated_title: DiscoveryAgent：一个以科学家为中心的智能体AI框架
translated_abstract: AI智能体可以辅助科学研究，但如何在自主探索与科学家检查和调整正在进行的工作的能力之间取得平衡，仍然是一个核心设计挑战。我们提出了DiscoveryAgent，这是一个领域无关、以科学家为中心的系统，它将自主探索与科学家主导的假设引导相结合。科学家可以在研究轮次之间选择、完善或替换假设，同时审计智能体通过查询检查点记录来追溯声明、复现分析并为后续决策提供信息。在两个预测建模任务中，DiscoveryAgent在所评估的基线中产生了最佳的变星分类器，并且在科学家的引导下，其蛋白质变异效应预测器仅被106个ProteinGym基线中的一个超越。我们开发了一个严格的检查点系统，使高度强大的审计智能体成为可能，这是对智能体研究的一种可扩展的监督形式。审计智能体能够自主识别错误……
tldr: DiscoveryAgent是一个以科学家为中心、领域无关的AI智能体框架，它通过让科学家在各轮研究之间选择、完善或替换假设，并结合基于严格检查点系统的强大审计智能体来追溯声明、复现分析和自主发现错误，实现了自主探索与可扩展人类监督的平衡。
en_tdlr: DiscoveryAgent is a scientist-centric, domain-agnostic agentic AI framework that combines autonomous investigation with scientist-directed hypothesis steering, and leverages a rigorous checkpointing system enabling highly capable audit agents as a scalable form of oversight for agentic research.
